scale_argument: Q2 in GeV^2; CT10 grid file lists Q, not Q2
legacy_literal_semantics: Parse DATA knots from unchanged source: D-exponent constants are Float64; unsuffixed/default-REAL constants are Float32 promoted to Float64. DSS14 **0.3 uses Float64(Float32(0.3))=0.30000001192092896, matching the compiled reference. No -fdefault-real-8.

CT10.reference: explicit LHAPDF continuation extrapolator; no production admission
CT10.alpha_s: not used; CSS coupling has its own explicit scientific contract
CT10.derivatives: no kinematic AD through C++; fixed input tables feed Julia parameterizations
CT10.concurrency: serialize provider calls within a process; use separate processes for different source roots

DSSV08.interpolation: bilinear in log(x), log(Q2) after removing source endpoint powers; endpoint x=1 is zero
DSSV08.range_evidence: actual locked source checks and knots; older header gives narrower Q2 values
DSSV08.public_output: unweighted u=(uv+ubar)/x, d=(dv+dbar)/x, antiquarks and gluon divided by x
DSSV08.unadmitted_flavors: public strange and heavy helicity mapping is withheld pending a separate source convention check
DSSV08.extrapolation: none: both policies reject outside source checks

DSS14.set: central pion NLO, IS=0 IL=0 IO=1
DSS14.interpolation: bilinear in log(z), log(Q2) after removing source endpoint powers; endpoint z=1 is zero
DSS14.pi_minus: swap light quark and antiquark; heavy and gluon unchanged
DSS14.pi_zero: arithmetic average of plus and minus
DSS14.strict: reject outside documented z and Q2 ranges
DSS14.reference: allow source log-linear Q2 extrapolation explicitly; retain z>=0.05

limitations: Input component only: no physical cross section, historical fit or uncertainty result
DSSV08 and DSS14 are secondary distributions of publication-tagged routines, not recovered KPSY fitting code
Legacy Fortran COMMON/SAVE reference programs run in fresh processes, unchanged
Low CSS mu_b lies below CT10 and DSS14 strict ranges; no hidden freeze, clamp or admission
No uncertainty eigenvectors or complete tensor-charge endpoint prescription
